# imferno

> SMPTE ST-2067 Interoperable Master Format for Rust, Node.js, and WebAssembly

## Reference

- [Rust API](/imferno/pr-108/reference/rust.md): imferno-core public API — validate, Imferno, ValidationReport, parsers.

## Others

- [Validation Codes](/imferno/pr-108/guide/codes.md): Every validation rule imferno checks, per spec and per edition.
- [Configuration](/imferno/pr-108/guide/config.md): Configure validation rules, severity overrides, and spec selection.
- [Examples](/imferno/pr-108/guide/examples.md): Working examples showing how to use imferno in your projects.
- [Introduction](/imferno/pr-108/guide/index.md): What imferno is, what IMF is, and why this exists.
- [IMF Packages](/imferno/pr-108/guide/packages.md): Understanding the structure of an IMP directory.
- [Getting Started](/imferno/pr-108/guide/quick-start.md): Parse and validate your first IMF package.
- [Validation](/imferno/pr-108/guide/validation.md): How imferno validates IMF packages and what the results mean.
- [CLI Reference](/imferno/pr-108/reference/cli.md): imferno CLI — validate IMF packages against SMPTE ST 2067.
- [Node.js API](/imferno/pr-108/reference/node.md): @imferno/node — native Node.js bindings with filesystem access.
- [Standards Coverage](/imferno/pr-108/reference/standards.md): Which SMPTE ST-2067 standards imferno implements and to what degree.
- [WASM API](/imferno/pr-108/reference/wasm.md): @imferno/wasm — WebAssembly bindings for JavaScript and TypeScript.
